fallsShort.why: On the site, the edge of an outlined card is Material 3's outline-variant role (md.comp.outlined-card.outline.color), about 1.6:1 on the surface, under 3:1. In dark mode the edge of an outlined card, and the outline of a block typed in place, on a coloured section is M3's outline role, 2.9:1 against the section's container. The theme uses M3's roles as printed; the editor's own cards keep a 3:1 edge.
